questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Near-point magnification M=1+D/f=1+25/(25/(3))=(3)+1; infinity-image case M=D/f।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: 10 mol ideal diatomic gas, vibrational modes frozen। U/(RT) কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Diatomic rigid molecule-এর degrees f=5। internal energy U=(f/2)nRT=(5×(10)/2)RT।

questions.question_bn: StarA ও Bobservedsameflux। Bdistance 9timesA। luminosityLB/LA কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। EqualF=L/(4πd²) impliesL∝d²։ Bdistancefactorngivesluminosityfactor (9)²,observedbrightnessnotintrinsicluminosity।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Proton ও alpha(q2e,m4mp)same accelerating potential 4Vthensame Bperpendicular। ralpha/rproton কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Afteraccelerationp=√(2mqV),r=p/(qB)∝√(m/q)। alpha/proton√((4m/2q)/(m/q))=√2।

questions.question_bn: Adiabatic expansion-এ gas 5 J work করে। ΔU কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Q=0 এবং convention ΔU=Q−Wby। তাই ΔU=−(5); expansion-এ internal energy কমে।

questions.question_bn: Series RLC-এ L=4H,C=1/4F। resonance angular frequency কত rad/s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Resonance XL=XC⇒ω²LC=1। LC=(4)·1/(4)=1⇒ω₀=1rad/s।

questions.question_bn: String length 1 m, wave speed 220 m/s। third harmonic frequency কত Hz?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Both ends fixed: fn=nmode v/(2L)। third harmonic=3·20×(11)/2=30×(11); parameter (11) harmonic index নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: A=(8±0.2) cm, B=(3±0.1) cm। A−B-এর maximum absolute uncertainty কত cm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Difference-এ worst-case absolute uncertainties যোগ: Δ(A−B)≤ΔA+ΔB=0.3 cm; measured values cancel।

questions.question_bn: Equal masses 3 kg, one at speed 4 m/s অন্য rest। stick together। lost kinetic energy কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Momentum gives final speed 2। initial K=8×(3), final K=½·2×(3)·4=4×(3)। loss=4×(3) J।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Radius 9 m frictionless vertical loop। bottom-এ minimum speed² কত যেন top-এ contact থাকে? g=10
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Top threshold vtop²=gr। bottom→top energy: vbottom²=vtop²+4gr=5gr=50×(9)।

questions.question_bn: Cell emf balance length 24 cm, terminal balance length 16 cm under external R=4Ω। internal r কত Ω?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। ε/V=l₁/l₂=3/2=(R+r)/R। r=R(l₁/l₂−1)=4·½=2Ω।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Stokes regime-এ একই material-এর sphere radius r ও 9r। terminal speed ratio second/first কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Drag 6πηrv, effective weight∝r³। balance থেকে terminal v∝r²; ratio (9)²।

questions.question_bn: Two identical isotope samples activities initially A and2A। after 3 half-lives activity ratio second/first কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Same decay constant means both activities multiply identical 2⁻ⁿ। ratio initially 2, পরে 2-ই থাকে।

questions.question_bn: v(t)=7−2t m/s, 0≤t≤7 s। total distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। v=0 at (7)/2। v-t graph-এর দুই triangle area (7)²/4 করে; distance মোট (7)²/2।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Same pendulum planet A period 20s,planet Bperiod 10s। gB/gA কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। T∝1/√g sameL。 gB/gA=(TA/TB)²=2²=4; period ratio inverted and squared।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Projectile initial velocity (15,20) m/s। air resistance নেই। top-এ speed কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Top-এ vertical velocity 0, horizontal unchanged 3×(5)। তাই speed=3×(5); পুরো velocity শূন্য নয়।

questions.question_bn: (NH₄)₂SO₄ sample 1584g। Nmass কত g? N14,H1,S32,O16
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Molar mass 132g/mol,samplenmol। each 2N⇒Nmass 2·14×(12)=28ng; fertilizer Npercentage 28/132×100।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Water[Ca²⁺]=26mmol/L, no Mg। CaCO₃ equivalent hardness কত mg/L? MCaCO₃100g/mol
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 26। Ca²⁺-এর 1mmol equivalent 1mmol CaCO₃।100g/mol⇒100mg/mmol; hardness 100nmg/L।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 2H₂+O₂→2H₂O। H₂=42 mol,O₂=14 mol। remainingH₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। O₂limitingn moluses 2nH₂। initial 3×(14) minusconsumed 2×(14) leavesn mol; product 2×(14) আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CathodereductionE°=10/10 V,anodereductionE°=−0.20 V। E°cell কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Ecell=Ecathode(reduction)−Eanode(reduction)=(10)/10−(−0.2)=((10)+2)/10 V; addoppositesigns।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acyclic hydrocarbon C6H12 with oneC=C, no ring। sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। C–C skeleton tree has (6)−1sigma, including double-bond oneσ। C–H bonds 2×(6)σ। total 3×(6)−1; πbond excluded।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=22D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=12 mol,H₂=24 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(12))/3,availableN₂(12) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(12)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 84mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 21mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। HClconsumed=4×(21)−(21)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 27mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। Reaction coefficients iodine 1 ও thiosulfate 2। তাই nmmol iodine fully titrate করতে 2nmmol thiosulfate।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Al³⁺+3e⁻→Al; charge 10F,100%efficiency,MAl27। aluminium কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Three electron per mole Al⇒(10)/3 mol Al। mass 27·(10)/3=9ng, oxidation state dependent।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 6 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 3 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Initial H⁺0.2×(3) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(3) mmol; excess 0.1×(3) mmol,total 3×(3) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=30×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((30)×10⁻²)=(1/(30))×10⁻⁸M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Principal shell n=14। maximum orbital count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Shell includes l=0…(14)−1। orbital sum Σ(2l+1)=(14)²। electron capacity 2×(14)², orbitals নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 6 mol triglyceride complete NaOH saponification-এ NaOH কত mol লাগে?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। প্রতি triglyceride-এ 3ester linkage। each 1 mol NaOH hydrolyses; total 3×(6) mol, glycerol ও উৎপন্ন।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻23M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(23)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: 25°C,nₑ=2,E°=0.2072 V। log₁₀K কত? use0.0592

questions.question_bn: Gas volume 11L at300 K,1atm। final 600 K,4atm। final volume কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Fixed gas amount combined law V₂/V₁=(T₂/T₁)(P₁/P₂)=2·¼=½। Celsius ব্যবহার নয়।

questions.question_bn: Gas A molar mass 25, B mass 100 g/mol। equalT-তে diffusion rA/rB কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Graham r∝1/√M। ratio√(MB/MA)=√4=2, inverse mass ratio 4 নয়।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 23%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। Convertedmass 1000·(23)/100=10nkg CaCO₃। CO₂mass fraction 44/100⇒4.4nkg; combustionemissionexcluded।

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 19mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। MnO₄⁻acidic Mn²⁺-এ 5electronaccepts। each Fe²⁺oneelectronloses⇒5Fe²⁺perpermanganate।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 11 mol primary alcohol RCH₂OH fully oxidise toRCOOH। total electron loss কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Alcohol carbon oxidation state increases 4units toacid। half-reaction 4electron per alcohol; aldehyde পর্যন্ত 2electron।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=16×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((4)²×10⁻⁹)=(4)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 3×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (3)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((3)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=3, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ureasample 840g। nitrogen mass কত g? CO(NH₂)₂,MW60
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Eachureamolecule 2nitrogen atoms⇒28g Nper 60gurea। sample 60nghas 28ngN; mass fraction not atom fraction।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food sample 2 kg-এ preservative 4mg। mass-based concentration কত ppm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Mass ppm=mg solute/kg sample। (4) mg/2 kg=(4)/2 ppm; total food mass denominator।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=18M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(18)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((18)−1), initial concentration নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃→CaO+CO₂। pure CaCO₃3000g,100%conversion। Ca Oyield কত g? MCaO 56
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। CaCO₃moles=(100×(30))/100=(30)। Ca Omoles 1:1×(30),mass 56ng; CO₂44ngsupports massbalance।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Preservative stock 2%w/v। final 3100 mL0.10%w/v solution-এ stock কত mL?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 31। Concentration dilution C₁V₁=C₂V₂⇒Vstock=0.10·100×(31)/2=5×(31) mL; তারপর final volume adjust।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: প্রতি molecule-এ 11 টি independent C≡C, অন্য unsaturation নেই।1 mol sample fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। প্রতি triple bond-এ twoπbonds; alkane পর্যন্ত saturation-এর জন্য 2H₂। মোট 2×(11) mol, semihydrogenation-এ(11)।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas mixture 22 mol N₂,2 mol O₂; total pressure 3atm। O₂ partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Dalton partial Poxygen=xo₂Ptotal=[2/((22)+2)]·3=6/((22)+2)atm। mole fraction relevant, mass fraction নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acyclic saturated hydrocarbon carbon count 20, C12,H1। molar mass কত g/mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Alkane formulaCₙH₂ₙ₊₂। molar mass 12×(20)+2×(20)+2=14×(20)+2; alkene mass 14×(20) আলাদা।
